title: Toward Inclusive Educational AI: Auditing Frontier LLMs through a Multiplexity Lens

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting cultural references from LLM responses to educational questions using a zero-shot classifier (GPT-4o) to calculate a Perspectives Distribution Score (PDS) and PDS Entropy, which measure the representation of different cultures. This is combined with sentiment analysis to assess the models' bias framing and tone toward various cultural perspectives (e.g., Western, Eastern, Islamic, African, Latin American).
